Elara stared at the horizon for a long moment, then walked back up to the lighthouse to make the call she hoped would not come too late.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一幅未完成的画。街灯将橙黄色的光晕投在湿润的路面上，倒影在积水中轻轻颤动。偶尔有一辆环卫车缓缓驶过，刷子摩擦地面的声音在寂静中显得格外清晰。便利店的灯彻夜亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹，收音机里传来低沉的老歌。高楼的某扇窗亮着灯，不知是失眠的人还是赶稿的人。远处偶有犬吠，随即归于沉寂。整座城市屏住呼吸，悬在黑夜与黎明之间，等待第一缕光将它重新唤醒。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something refers to itself to solve a problem — like looking up a word in a dictionary and finding it defined using itself.\n• Imagine you want to count stairs: you say \"the number of stairs is 1 plus however many stairs come after this one,\" and you keep asking that same question until there are no stairs left.\n• Every recursive solution needs a stopping point (called a base case), otherwise it would keep asking the same question forever and never finish."}
